programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: While out hunting, Llewelyn Moss (Josh Brolin) finds the grisly aftermath of a drug deal. Though he knows better, he cannot resist the cash left behind and takes it with him. The hunter becomes the hunted when a merciless killer named Chigurh (Javier Bardem) picks up his trail. Also looking for Moss is Sheriff Bell (Tommy Lee Jones), an aging lawman who reflects on a changing world and a dark secret of his own, as he tries to find and protect Moss.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Doctor Louis Creed (Dale Midkiff) moves his family to Maine, where he meets a friendly local named Jud Crandall (Fred Gwynne). After the Creeds' cat is accidentally killed, Crandall advises Louis to bury it in the ground near the old pet cemetery. The cat returns to life, its personality changed for the worse. When Louis' son, Gage (Miko Hughes), dies tragically, Louis decides to bury the boy's body in the same ground despite the warnings of Crandall and Louis' visions of a deceased patient.

programme.title: Jackass: The Movie
programme.desc: In this comedic documentary, Johnny Knoxville heads a crew of stuntmen, skateboarders and all-around lunatics as they prank, embarrass and torture each other in the name of fun. The antics range from childlike -- the boys don panda suits for a romp through Tokyo -- to grotesque and life-threatening. A golf cart demolition derby turns downright dangerous. Live gators nearly chomp maniac Steve-O. Filmmaker Spike Jonze and Knoxville, in heavy makeup, test the public's patience for the elderly.

programme.title: Jackass: Number Two
programme.desc: Daredevils (Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Steve-O) go for the gross-out when they subject an unsuspecting public to more outrageous stunts and practical jokes. Danger, pain and bodily fluids are in plentiful supply as the gang tries to up the ante in the continuous quest to shock and annoy.

programme.title: The Wood
programme.desc: Three old friends -- Mike (Omar Epps), Roland (Taye Diggs) and Slim (Richard T. Jones) -- recount memories of their shared childhood in Inglewood, Calif., as they prepare for Roland's wedding to his fiancée, Lisa (LisaRaye). When the groom goes missing without a word, Mike and Slim struggle to find their nervous friend and return him to his impatient bride before the wedding begins. Along the way, they continue to swap stories about lessons learned during their awkward teenage years.

programme.title: Monstrous
programme.desc: A terrifying new horror awaits Laura and her 7-year-old son, Cody, when then they flee her abusive ex-husband and try to settle into a new life in an idyllic and remote lakeside farmhouse. Still traumatized, their physical and mental well-being are pushed to the limit as their fragile existence is threatened.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity: The Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Ryan Fleege, wife Emily, and their 7-year-old daughter, Leila, prepare for Christmas in their new home. After finding an old and mysterious camcorder, Ryan quickly learns that it can record strange apparitions that are invisible to the naked eye. When young Leila starts talking to an imaginary friend and displaying strange behavior, the couple soon find themselves in a terrifying battle with a supernatural force.

programme.title: Captive
programme.desc: Brian Nichols (David Oyelowo) becomes the subject of a citywide manhunt after breaking out of a courthouse jail and killing four people. His frantic escape brings him to the apartment of Ashley Smith (Kate Mara), a single mother and recovering methamphetamine addict. Held hostage by Nichols in her own home, the scared woman looks for guidance from "The Purpose Driven Life," Rick Warren's best-selling, inspirational book. As she reads aloud, Ashley and her would-be killer come to a crossroad.

programme.title: Sinister
programme.desc: True-crime writer Ellison Oswald is in a slump; he hasn't had a bestseller in more than 10 years and is becoming increasingly desperate for a hit. So, when he discovers the existence of a snuff film showing the deaths of a family, he vows to solve the mystery. He moves his own family into the victims' home and gets to work. However, when old film footage and other clues hint at the presence of a supernatural force, Ellison learns that living in the house may be fatal.

programme.title: Frank Miller's Sin City
programme.desc: In this quartet of neo-noir tales, a mysterious salesman (Josh Hartnett) narrates a tragic story of co-dependency, while a musclebound vigilante (Mickey Rourke) tears his way through the criminal underworld in search of his lost love (Jaime King). In another part of the city, a grizzled cop (Bruce Willis) foils the ambitions of a child-killer (Nick Stahl), and an ex-prostitute (Brittany Murphy) evades her ex-pimp (Benicio Del Toro) with the help of her new boyfriend, Dwight (Clive Owen).

programme.title: Jackass 3
programme.desc: Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Steve-O, Wee Man and the rest of their fearless and foolhardy friends take part in another round of outrageous pranks and stunts. In addition to standing in the path of a charging bull, launching themselves into the air and crashing through various objects, the guys perform in segments such as "Sweatsuit Cocktail," "Beehive Tetherball" and "Lamborghini Tooth Pull."

programme.title: Old Guy
programme.desc: An aging hit man must train a young prodigy when his employer moves to replace the old guard. However, when they learn they're being betrayed, the unlikely pair turns into a lethal team -- with their double-crossing bosses in their sights.

programme.title: A.C.O.D.
programme.desc: An attempt to negotiate a truce between his bitterly divorced parents sends a man (Adam Scott) back to his childhood therapist, where he learns he was the subject of her self-help book.

programme.title: Paycheck
programme.desc: Michael Jennings is a top-notch reverse engineer. Corporations pay him to crack the secrets of their competitors' products. When the job is done, he has his memory of it erased. Rethrick, head of a company called Allcom, hires Jennings to reverse-engineer a secret government device. After the job, Jennings wakes from the memory erasure to find himself being chased by various agencies. He soon realizes that the fate of the entire world may be in his hands.

programme.title: Titanic
programme.desc: Two young lovers from different backgrounds meet and fall in love on the ill-fated maiden voyage of the unsinkable R.M.S. Titanic.

programme.title: Cheech & Chong Still Smokin'
programme.desc: Stoners Cheech and Chong reunite and head to Amsterdam for a film festival after getting tickets from a promoter in L.A. When they show up at a celebrity party, Cheech is mistaken for Burt Reynolds, and Chong for Dolly Parton. The duo rolls with it as they roll more joints, partake in the usual antics and eat every item -- which include a lot of mushrooms -- on the menu at Amsterdam's Bvlgar Café.

programme.title: Cheech & Chong's Last Movie
programme.desc: Cheech Marin and Tommy Chong discuss their lifelong friendship and popularity as a comedic duo. Features interviews, sketches and never-before-seen footage spanning their five-decade career.

programme.title: Cypher
programme.desc: Morgan Sullivan (Jeremy Northam) is an accountant anxious for a more exciting life. He gets his chance when Digicorp hires him as a corporate spy. While carrying out his first missions, however, Sullivan keeps crossing paths with an enigmatic woman named Rita (Lucy Liu), who claims Digicorp is brainwashing him. Soon Morgan is questioning everything about his life, including his own identity -- making things increasingly complicated when he becomes a double agent for Digicorp's rival, Sunways.

programme.title: Sexipede
programme.desc: Beautiful women make your erotic dreams come true.

programme.title: Total Recall
programme.desc: Douglas Quaid is a bored construction worker in the year 2084 who dreams of visiting colonized Mars. He visits "Rekall," a company that plants false memories into people's brains, in order to experience the thrill of Mars without having to travel there. But something goes wrong during the procedure; Quaid discovers that his entire life is actually a false memory and that the people who implanted it in his head now want him dead.

programme.title: Star Trek: Nemesis
programme.desc: Capt. Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) diverts the starship Enterprise from its scheduled trip to Cmdr. Riker (Jonathan Frakes) and Counselor Troi's (Marina Sirtis) wedding to negotiate a peace treaty with the Romulans. Picard is shocked when Shinzon (Tom Hardy), the new Praetor of the Romulans, admits to being a clone of him. When the crew members discover a break-in on their computer, they are forced into a life-or-death battle to stop Shinzon's Warbird before it can destroy the Earth.

programme.title: The Hoax
programme.desc: In the early 1970s, author Clifford Irving (Richard Gere), with accomplice Richard Suskind (Alfred Molina), attempts to pull off one of the greatest media scams of the century. He writes a fake biography of reclusive billionaire Howard Hughes, claiming that Hughes authorized it, and sells the book to publishing giant McGraw-Hill.

programme.title: 2 Days in the Valley
programme.desc: Dosmo Pizzo (Danny Aiello), an ordinary guy, finds himself involved in a murder-for-hire scheme. He is betrayed by his partner, the strangely serene Lee Woods (James Spader), who leaves him for dead. Suspecting that Woods will come back to finish him, Dosmo takes an obnoxious art dealer (Greg Cruttwell) and his sweet-natured assistant (Glenne Headly) hostage. Meanwhile, a rookie policeman (Eric Stoltz) investigating the murder begins to suspect that some kind of conspiracy is behind it.

programme.title: Ella Enchanted
programme.desc: As a baby, Ella (Anne Hathaway) receives a visit from Lucinda (Vivica A. Fox), her fairy godmother, and is bestowed with a magical talent that requires her to obey anything that she is told to do. This proves to be more of a curse than a blessing, particularly once her mother dies and she is forced to live with the cruel Dame Olga (Joanna Lumley). Eventually, Ella embarks on a journey to find Lucinda and break the spell, accompanied by the handsome Prince Charmont (Hugh Dancy).

programme.title: Chocolat
programme.desc: When mysterious Vianne and her child arrive in a tranquil French town in the winter of 1959, no one could have imagined the impact that she and her spirited daughter would have on the community stubbornly rooted in tradition. Within days, she opens an unusual chocolate shop, across the square from the church. Her ability to perceive her customers' desires and satisfy them with just the right confection, coaxes the villagers to abandon themselves to temptation -- just as Lent begins.

programme.title: Shall We Dance?
programme.desc: Despite having a great career and a loving family, lawyer John Clark (Richard Gere) is missing something in his life as he meanders listlessly from day to day. On his commute back home one night, Clark notices a stunning woman (Jennifer Lopez) in a dance studio and decides on a whim to join a class for ballroom dancing. While Clark finds a new spark in his life, his wife, Beverly (Susan Sarandon), grows suspicious of his frequent absences, since he decides to keep his dancing a secret.

programme.title: Superstar
programme.desc: Orphaned after the death of her parents and raised by her strict grandmother (Glynis Johns), awkward Roman Catholic high-school student Mary Katherine Gallagher (Molly Shannon) dreams about dating popular student Sky Corrigan (Will Ferrell) and becoming a star. To achieve both goals, Mary enters a talent contest, where her competitor is Sky's girlfriend, Evian Graham (Elaine Hendrix). Despite her grandmother's opposition, Mary prepares to win both the contest and Sky's affection.

programme.title: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Sad little rich girl Alyssa (Ashley Olsen) and orphaned tomboy Amanda (Mary-Kate Olsen) meet at summer camp and discover that they are each other's exact double. And each girl is worried about her caregiver. Alyssa's father, Roger (Steve Guttenberg), is about to marry a gold digger, and Amanda's kind social worker, Diane (Kirstie Alley), will be pushed aside if a cruel family adopts Amanda. The girls decide to switch identities to make their loved ones fall in love with each other.

programme.title: Ella Enchanted
programme.desc: As a baby, Ella (Anne Hathaway) receives a visit from Lucinda (Vivica A. Fox), her fairy godmother, and is bestowed with a magical talent that requires her to obey anything that she is told to do. This proves to be more of a curse than a blessing, particularly once her mother dies and she is forced to live with the cruel Dame Olga (Joanna Lumley). Eventually, Ella embarks on a journey to find Lucinda and break the spell, accompanied by the handsome Prince Charmont (Hugh Dancy).

programme.title: An Inconvenient Truth
programme.desc: Filmmaker Davis Guggenheim follows Al Gore on the lecture circuit, as the former presidential candidate campaigns to raise public awareness of the dangers of global warming and calls for immediate action to curb its destructive effects on the environment.

programme.title: Runaway Bride
programme.desc: (CC) Catch Her If You Can. 'Roberts and Gere confirm their status as an eternal screen team' in this delightful laugh-filled romantic comedy. Roberts plays small-town girl Maggie Carpenter, whose marches down the aisle become a series of near Mrs. when she bolts before saying 'I do.' Gere is Ike Graham, a cynical, big-city newspaper columnist eager to write a tell-all story about Maggie. But the more Ike finds out about the skittish Maggie, the more he finds he's falling in love.

programme.title: Failure to Launch
programme.desc: A young man (Matthew McConaughey) continues to live at the home of parents who, in desperation to push him out of the nest once and for all, hatch a plan. They hire a beautiful woman (Sarah Jessica Parker) to entice him to assume the mantle of responsibility and get his own place.

programme.title: Fight or Flight
programme.desc: A mercenary takes on the job of tracking a high-value asset known only as "The Ghost" on an international flight. Realizing the plane is filled with assassins assigned to kill them both, the pair must work together in a fight for their lives.

programme.title: Assassination Nation
programme.desc: High school senior Lily and her three best friends live in a haze of texts, posts, selfies and chats -- just like the rest of the world. Their small town gets turned upside down when an anonymous hacker starts to reveal personal messages and secrets of thousands of people. As anger erupts into full-blown violence, the four girls soon find themselves in a fight for their lives as a mob of armed residents takes it to the streets.

programme.title: Jay and Silent Bob Strike Back
programme.desc: When Jay and Silent Bob learn that a Bluntman and Chronic movie is being made featuring their comic book counterparts, they drool at the thought of fat movie checks rolling in. But when the pair find that there won't be any royalties coming their way, they set out to sabotage the flick at all costs.

programme.title: Baby Driver
programme.desc: Talented getaway driver Baby relies on the beat of his personal soundtrack to be the best in the game. After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom.

programme.title: Pretty Red Dress
programme.desc: The story of Travis, Candice and their daughter, Kenisha, and their relationships with the same red dress.

programme.desc: Involuntarily discharged from the Army, a special forces sergeant lands a contract with a private underground military force. When his very first assignment goes awry, the elite soldier finds himself hunted and on the run, caught in a dangerous conspiracy and fighting to stay alive long enough to get home and uncover the true motives of those who betrayed him.

programme.title: Universal Soldier
programme.desc: During the Vietnam War, soldier Luc Devereaux (Jean-Claude Van Damme) finds that his superior officer, Andrew Scott (Dolph Lundgren), has turned violently deranged, and the two fight to the death. After their bodies are retrieved, they are placed into a secret program in which they are reanimated and trained to become unquestioning killing machines. While Devereaux and Scott initially have no memory of their former lives, glimpses of their pasts start to return, rekindling their intense conflict.

programme.title: American Assassin
programme.desc: When Cold War veteran Stan Hurley takes CIA black ops recruit Mitch Rapp under his wing, they receive an assignment to investigate a wave of random attacks on both military and civilian targets. After discovering a pattern of violence, Hurley and Rapp join forces with a lethal Turkish agent to stop a mysterious operative who wants to start a global war.

programme.title: Welcome to Sarajevo
programme.desc: Michael Henderson is a reporter covering the war in Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina. He develops a competitive friendship with Flynn, an arrogant TV reporter, as they cover the chaos and suffering occurring around them. When Henderson reports on a dilapidated orphanage, he becomes affected by the plight of its occupants. With the help of an American aid worker named Nina, Henderson tries to find a way to smuggle the children out of the country.

programme.title: Maniac
programme.desc: A serial killer (Elijah Wood) removes his victims' scalps and attaches them to the vintage mannequins he restores in his late mother's shop.

Suddenly under siege, the friends seem headed to the point of no return -- unless one man can reach them in time.

programme.title: Day of the Fight

programme.title: Camp X-Ray
programme.desc: A female guard at Guantánamo Bay forms an unlikely friendship with one of the facility's longtime detainees.

programme.desc: Cantankerous old buzzard Woody Grant can barely walk down the street of his home in Billings, Mont., without stopping for a drink. So when Woody receives receives a sweepstakes notice in the mail and insists on making a 750-mile trip to Lincoln, Neb., to collect his prize, it falls to baffled son David to accompany him. During a stop in their Nebraska hometown, word gets out about Woody's fortune, first making him a hero, then later, the target of predatory people.

programme.desc: An all-star cast sparks this captivating comedy about a group of old friends whose 10-year high school reunion creates some hilariously unexpected surprises. Willie (Timothy Hutton), Tommy (Matt Dillon), and Paul may have lost a bit of their youth, but they're still ready to party with Uma Thurman, Rosie O'Donnell, Lauren Holly, and Mira Sorvino -- the beautiful girls who've turned their lives upside down!

programme.desc: In an ordinary suburban house, on a lovely tree-lined street, in the middle of 1970s America, lived the five beautiful, dreamy Lisbon sisters, whose doomed fates indelibly marked the neighborhood boys who to this day continue to obsess over them. A story of love and repression, fantasy and terror, sex and death, memory and longing. It is at its core a mystery story: a heart-rending investigation into the impenetrable, life-altering secrets of American adolescence.

programme.desc: Dispatched on an assignment, New York City-based fashion photographer Dick Avery (Fred Astaire) is struck by the beauty of Jo Stockton (Audrey Hepburn), a shy bookstore employee he's photographed by accident, who he believes has the potential to become a successful model. He gets Jo to go with him to France, where he snaps more pictures of her against iconic Parisian backdrops. In the process, they fall for one another, only to find hurdles in their way.

programme.title: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street
programme.desc: Evil Judge Turpin (Alan Rickman) lusts for the beautiful wife of a London barber (Johnny Depp) and transports him to Australia for a crime he did not commit. Returning after 15 years and calling himself Sweeney Todd, the now-mad man vows revenge, applying his razor to unlucky customers and shuttling the bodies down to Mrs. Lovett (Helena Bonham Carter), who uses them in her meat-pie shop. Though many fall to his blade, he will not be satisfied until he slits Turpin's throat.

programme.title: All I Wanna Do
programme.desc: During the early 1960s, high school teen Odette Sinclair (Gaby Hoffman) is transferred, to her great dismay, from a coed institution to an all-girls New England boarding school. After learning that plans are in the works to merge Miss Godard's School for Girls with a nearby boys institution, she and her sorority sister, Verena von Stefan (Kirsten Dunst), go on strike against the school. Throughout, the pair are pitted against meddling school monitor Abigail Sawyer (Rachael Leigh Cook).

programme.title: She's Having a Baby
programme.desc: Jake (Kevin Bacon) and Kristy Briggs (Elizabeth McGovern) have made the leap from high school sweethearts to newlyweds, but married life is not what Jake expected. While he fantasizes about a dream girl and envies the lifestyle of his single best friend (Alec Baldwin), Kristy is ready to have a baby. Instead of sharing this with Jake, she opts to secretly stop taking birth control. However, Kristy comes clean after failing to become pregnant, prompting Jake to go to a fertility clinic.

programme.title: Hotel for Dogs
programme.desc: After moving into a foster home that forbids pets, siblings Andi and Bruce must quickly find a home for their dog, Friday. The resourceful pair finds an abandoned hotel, and with the help of Bruce's mechanical skills, turn it into a pooch paradise for Friday and a number of strays. But when the inevitable barking makes neighbors suspicious, Andi and Bruce must find a way to hide their canine haven from prying eyes.

programme.title: Wickensburg
programme.desc: When a mother and her young son move to a small town, they soon discover the town harbors a dark secret.

Une femme déterminée à trouver une personne bien précise, dotée d'un pouvoir spécial, destinée à devenir un chef spirituel prodigieux.

programme.title: Emmett Till
programme.desc: La véritable histoire de la poursuite incessante de justice de Mamie Till-Mobley pour son fils de 14 ans, Emmett Till, qui a été brutalement lynché en 1955 alors qu'il rendait visite à ses cousins dans le Mississippi.

programme.title: Dalloway
programme.desc: Clarissa, romancière en mal d'inspiration, rejoint une résidence d'artistes prestigieuse à la pointe de la technologie. Elle trouve en Dalloway, son assistante virtuelle, un soutien et même une confidente qui l'aide à écrire. Mais peu à peu, Clarissa éprouve un malaise face au comportement de plus en plus intrusif de son IA, renforcé par les avertissements d'un autre résident. Se sentant alors surveillée, Clarissa se lance dans une enquête pour découvrir les réelles intentions de ses hôtes.

programme.title: Tarte aux morts: une enquête de Hannah Swensen
programme.desc: L'émission de téléréalité préférée d'Hannah prend le contrôle de "The Cookie Jar." Lorsque le producteur est retrouvé mort, Hannah et Norman font équipe pour retrouver le meurtrier. Chad invite Hannah au tribunal.

programme.title: Un de ces jours
programme.desc: Dreux et Alyssa louent un appartement dans un immeuble majoritairement habité par des personnes de la communauté afro-américaine. Lorsque le petit ami d'Alyssa dilapide l'argent de leur loyer, les deux jeunes femmes sont sommées par leur propriétaire de payer la totalité de leur mensualité sous peine d'éviction. Elles disposent de neuf heures pour recouvrer le montant dû. Une véritable course contre la montre est lancée et toutes les options doivent être envisagées.

programme.title: Mon ami Robot
programme.desc: Dans un univers peuplé d'animaux où il est possible de fabriquer des robots pour pallier la solitude, Dog, un chien new-yorkais, se fait un nouvel ami: Robot. Ils jouent à la console, se baladent à Central Park, et deviennent vite inséparables. Lorsqu'un voyage à la plage laisse son ami Robot rouillé et immobilisé dans le sable, Dog doit malheureusement retourner seul à sa vie d'avant.

programme.title: Méchantes ados
programme.desc: Après une enfance heureuse en Afrique, Cady, 16 ans, découvre une scolarité normale au sein d'un lycée américain. Elle est alors accueillie au sommet de la chaîne alimentaire sociale par un groupe d'élite de filles populaires appelé les Plastiques, dirigé par Regina George. Cependant, lorsque Cady commet l'erreur de tomber amoureuse de l'ex-petit ami de Regina, elle se retrouve rapidement dans leur ligne de mire.

The two strike up a whirlwind romance, but Arthur is sent overseas and killed. programme.title: La reina Victoria
programme.desc: Victoria fue monarca de Inglaterra a los 18. En los primeros años de su reinado, Victoria tuvo que enfrentarse a varios intentos de manipulación y a un romance con su primo. Drama y romanticismo se dan la mano en esta cuidadísima producción basada en la juventud de la reina Victoria, en la que destaca la excelente ambientación del filme. De hecho, la cinta fue candidata al Oscar al mejor maquillaje y dirección artística; y se hizo con la estatuilla al mejor diseño de vestuario. Si bien muchos hechos fueron modificados respecto a los originales, algunos escenarios escogidos son reales. Así, numerosas secuencias fueron rodadas en el castillo de Belvoir y la cama usada en uno de los fragmentos es el mueble real en el que durmió la reina en 1843. Además, los actores lucen vestidos que son auténticas réplicas de los originales y algunas piezas están valoradas en más de 10.000 euros. A parte del virtuosismo en la ambientación, destaca especialmente la interpretación de la protagonista, Emily Blunt, que ya consiguió llamar poderosamente la atención en ''El diablo viste de Prada''.

programme.title: Mensajero del futuro
programme.desc: En el año 2013, el mundo está devastado tras una catástrofe nuclear. Toda la tecnología ha desaparecido y la población lucha por sobrevivir ante los ataques de un ejército tirano, los Holnists, que recluta a sus soldados entre los más fuertes de los supervivientes. En este contexto, un fugitivo encuentra una saca de correo abandonada y se dedica a repartirlo. Este simple hecho sirve como recordatorio para la gente de su pasada forma de vida y acaba convirtiéndole en el líder de una revuelta contra los Holnists. Kevin Costner se basó en la novela futurista homonima de David Brin para dirigir y producir su segundo trabajo como director tras ''Bailando con lobos''. Al igual que los últimos trabajos en los que había intervenido el actor (''Wyatt Earp'', ''Waterworld'', ''The War''), el filme no tuvo demasiada suerte y, después de sufrir varios percances durante el rodaje, su acogida fue muy fría tanto por parte del público como de la crítica.

programme.title: La caza
programme.desc: Doce extraños se despiertan en el claro de un bosque sin saber cómo llegaron allí. Desconocen que han sido elegidos para ser cazados en una especie de deporte en el que un grupo de ricos matan a personas por simple diversión. Thriller y terror se dan la mano en esta cinta dirigida por Craig Zobel, que está escrita por Nick Cuse y Damon Lindelof. Los tres ya habían trabajado codo con codo en la aclamada serie de televisión ''The Leftovers''. Esta violenta sátira sobre un mundo donde los humanos se cazan entre sí como si de un deporte se tratase está protagonizada por Betty Gilpin (''GLOW''), cuyo personaje -una de las presas- se rebela para darle la vuelta al juego y deshacerse uno a uno de los miembros de la élite que intentan darles caza. La oscarizada Hilary Swank y Emma Roberts (''Somos los Miller'') completan el elenco principal. El proyecto se vio envuelto en polémica ya que, en agosto de 2019, Universal Studios canceló el estreno de la cinta (previsto para setiembre) debido a los tiroteos masivos que tuvieron lugar en las localidades estadounidenses de Dayton y El Paso. La decisión se tomó un día después de que el presidente Donald Trump publicara críticas sobre la película.

programme.title: Cisne negro
programme.desc: Nina logra el papel de bailarina principal en un importante espectáculo de danza clásica. La presión de una madre controladora, la rivalidad con una compañera y las exigencias de su director le harán enloquecer. Darren Aronofsky embruja de nuevo al espectador con esta asfixiante propuesta que navega entre el drama y el suspense psicológico. Tras sacar del olvido a Mickey Rourke en ''El Luchador'', el cineasta brindó una enorme oportunidad a una intérprete. Esta vez, la elegida fue Natalie Portman, que se alzó con el Oscar a la mejor actriz y con un sinfín de premios en la misma categoría. El increíble esfuerzo de Portman -un entrenamiento de un año, nueve kilos perdidos y una costilla dislocada por el camino- le condujeron a un éxito más que justificado. Aronofsky confesó que manipuló sutilmente a Mila Kunis (''Con derecho a roce'') y a Portman para que su tensión a nivel personal se plasmara en el terreno interpretativo. Con un final apoteósico y un poderío visual hipnótico, la cinta -que optó a cuatro estatuillas más- permanecerá en la retina de los críticos y en la de millones de espectadores. De hecho, la recaudación multiplicó por 25 el ajustadísimo presupuesto invertido.

programme.title: Hijos de los hombres
programme.desc: Año 2027. La humanidad ha perdido la capacidad de procrear y el mundo se estremece ante la noticia de la muerte de la persona más joven del planeta, que tenía 18 años. En medio del caos, las autoridades contratan a Theo, un desilusionado exactivista, para proteger a la persona más buscada de la Tierra. Película de ciencia ficción distópica basada en la novela homónima de PD James y dirigida por el mexicano Alfonso Cuarón (''Y tu mamá también''). El colapso de la sociedad, el terrorismo y la destrucción del medio ambiente acompañan en el filme a una casi imparable extinción de la humanidad. El protagonismo recayó en Clive Owen (''Sin City'', ''Closer''), quien supo impregnarse bien del talento de los secundarios Michael Caine y Julianne Moore. Cuarón también acertó en la brillante fotografía de Emmanuel Lubezki, un profesional que tiene en su currículo la parte visual de filmes de la talla de ''Sleepy Hollow'', ''Cosas que diría con sólo mirarla'' o ''Quemar después de leer''. Gracias a ''Hijos de los hombres'', Lubezki consiguió su cuarta candidatura a los premios Oscar, aunque se volvió a quedar sin la preciada estatuilla.

programme.title: Arma letal
programme.desc: Murtaugh y Riggs buscan al culpable de un robo que acaba en homicidio. Murtaugh y Trish cuestionan su confianza en Riana cuando se mete en problemas con nuevos amigos. Mientras, Riggs recuerda su problemática infancia y encuentra una familia en Molly y Ben.

programme.title: Pacto de silencio
programme.desc: Un antiguo activista radical vive de forma anónima con su hija en los alrededores de Albany. Pero su tranquila vida dará un vuelco cuando un periodista revele su paradero al FBI. Robert Redford se volvió a poner ante y tras las cámaras para crear este thriller de acción política que hace un homenaje al idealismo de la década de 1960. Y lo hace siguiendo su ya habitual predilección por mostrar las encrucijadas morales de su país natal: si ya lo mostró como actor en ''Tal como éramos'' (la lista negra de Hollywood); o ''Todos los hombres del presidente'' (el caso Watergate); como director lo volvió a hacer con los escándalos de los concursos televisivos (''Quiz Show''), el polémico asesinato de Lincoln (''La conspiración'') o la guerra en Afganistán (''Leones por corderos''). En esta ocasión, confió en el guionista Lem Dobbs (''Dark City'') para adaptar al audiovisual la novela ''The Company You Keep'', de Neil Gordon, una muestra del complejo legado del radicalismo de la época de la guerra del Vietnam. Destaca el gran elenco de actores que arropan al célebre intérprete de ''El golpe'', entre los que destacan Shia LaBeouf (''Transformers''), Julie Christie, Susan Sarandon y Nick Nolte.

programme.title: Tercera identidad
programme.desc: Sally es una artista estadounidense casada con Leo Cauffield, un periodista inglés que trabaja a tiempo parcial para la inteligencia británica en el Beirut de finales de los 50. Una tarde, Leo sale de su casa y desaparece. Preocupada, Sally ve cómo se derrumba su vida cuando la Embajada de Gran Bretaña le comunica que sospechan que Leo ha desertado y se ha pasado al bando comunista. Sally dedicará todas sus fuerzas a encontrar a su marido para conocer la verdad. Marek Kanievska (''Otro país'') dirige este thriller construido alrededor de una historia real que tuvo lugar en los 60, en plena Guerra Fría. Rupert Everett (''La boda de mi mejor amigo''), con quien Kanievska ya había trabajado en ''Otro país'', y Sharon Stone (''Casino'') forman el dúo de lujo que protagoniza la película. La química entre ellos, sin embargo, se echa de menos, convirtiendo en una cinta más bien plana lo que podría haber sido un gran drama romántico.

programme.title: La reina Victoria
programme.desc: Victoria fue monarca de Inglaterra a los 18. En los primeros años de su reinado, Victoria tuvo que enfrentarse a varios intentos de manipulación y a un romance con su primo. Drama y romanticismo se dan la mano en esta cuidadísima producción basada en la juventud de la reina Victoria, en la que destaca la excelente ambientación del filme. De hecho, la cinta fue candidata al Oscar al mejor maquillaje y dirección artística; y se hizo con la estatuilla al mejor diseño de vestuario. Si bien muchos hechos fueron modificados respecto a los originales, algunos escenarios escogidos son reales. Así, numerosas secuencias fueron rodadas en el castillo de Belvoir y la cama usada en uno de los fragmentos es el mueble real en el que durmió la reina en 1843. Además, los actores lucen vestidos que son auténticas réplicas de los originales y algunas piezas están valoradas en más de 10.000 euros. A parte del virtuosismo en la ambientación, destaca especialmente la interpretación de la protagonista, Emily Blunt, que ya consiguió llamar poderosamente la atención en ''El diablo viste de Prada''.

programme.title: Implacable
programme.desc: Tras el asesinato de su hija adolescente y el secuestro de una de sus estudiantes, Harry, entrenador de secundaria, decide dar caza a los responsables.

programme.title: Cisne negro
programme.desc: Nina logra el papel de bailarina principal en un importante espectáculo de danza clásica. La presión de una madre controladora, la rivalidad con una compañera y las exigencias de su director le harán enloquecer. Darren Aronofsky embruja de nuevo al espectador con esta asfixiante propuesta que navega entre el drama y el suspense psicológico. Tras sacar del olvido a Mickey Rourke en ''El Luchador'', el cineasta brindó una enorme oportunidad a una intérprete. Esta vez, la elegida fue Natalie Portman, que se alzó con el Oscar a la mejor actriz y con un sinfín de premios en la misma categoría. El increíble esfuerzo de Portman -un entrenamiento de un año, nueve kilos perdidos y una costilla dislocada por el camino- le condujeron a un éxito más que justificado. Aronofsky confesó que manipuló sutilmente a Mila Kunis (''Con derecho a roce'') y a Portman para que su tensión a nivel personal se plasmara en el terreno interpretativo. Con un final apoteósico y un poderío visual hipnótico, la cinta -que optó a cuatro estatuillas más- permanecerá en la retina de los críticos y en la de millones de espectadores. De hecho, la recaudación multiplicó por 25 el ajustadísimo presupuesto invertido.

Inicialmente se emitieron cuatro capítulos, entre 1997 y 1998, en la cadena FOX de Estados Unidos y en ITV y Sky en Reino Unido. El 15 de mayo del 2002 Fox retomó el formato original con Breaking the Magician's Code: Magic's Biggest Secrets Finally Revealed 5 y 6 (Rompiendo el código de los magos: Los más grandes secretos de la magia finalmente revelados 5 y 6). programme.title: Historias de la Virgen morena
programme.desc: A veces los problemas del día a día pueden solucionarse con un poco de ayuda milagrosa. programme.title: Historias de la Virgen morena
programme.desc: A veces los problemas del día a día pueden solucionarse con un poco de ayuda milagrosa. Esta exitosa serie muestra casos de la vida real en los cuales los protagonistas se enfrentan a grandes encrucijadas o a situaciones terribles, y no les queda más remedio que pedir un milagro. Es allí cuando la fe se pone a prueba y se vuelve poderosa, pues demuestra que de la situación más terrible se puede salir. Pensado para quienes creen que la fe mueve montañas, esta conmovedora serie muestra la manera en la que los protagonistas se encomiendan a la Virgen Morena buscando resolver sus dificultades.
